title: Add new release repositories [rosx_introspection]
author: facontidavide
body:
* Name of the release team:  can I piggyback on the **plotjuggler_team** , since this library is primarily used there?

Otherwise I can request a new release team.

* Release repositories to add: 

  * [rosx_introspection](https://github.com/facontidavide/rosx_introspection)
    * ros/rosdistro source entry: see https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/41657

comments.author: facontidavide
comments.body:
Hi, now that https://github.com/ros/rosdistro/pull/41657 was merged, I think we can move on with this.

Shall I propose a new release team with me as user?

comments.author: nuclearsandwich
comments.body: Thanks for the patience here @facontidavide we can use plotjuggler team.
